title: Underwriting Chart: Cardinal Personal Auto Policy Package Entry Gates
content:
Each coverage package of the Cardinal Personal Auto Policy has its own entry gates. The incident gates are counted across all rated drivers on the policy in the lookback; the licensing, prior insurance and age gates concern the named insured. The chart also shows whether the package allows a named driver exclusion and whether it may carry a financial-responsibility filing (SR-22 or FR-44).

## Entry gates

| Gate | Cardinal Auto Essential | Cardinal Auto Basic | Cardinal Auto Standard | Cardinal Auto Plus | Cardinal Auto Preferred | Cardinal Auto Premier |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Most major violations allowed | 2 | 1 | 1 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Most minor violations allowed | 4 | 3 | 3 | 2 | 2 | 1 |
| Most chargeable at-fault accidents allowed | 3 | 2 | 2 | 1 | 1 | 1 |
| Fewest full years since the named insured was first licensed | 0 | 0 | 1 | 2 | 3 | 5 |
| Fewest months of continuous prior auto insurance immediately before new business | 0 | 0 | 6 | 6 | 12 | 12 |
| Youngest age of the named insured, years | 18 | 18 | 18 | 18 | 18 | 18 |

## Package permissions

| Permission | Cardinal Auto Essential | Cardinal Auto Basic | Cardinal Auto Standard | Cardinal Auto Plus | Cardinal Auto Preferred | Cardinal Auto Premier |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| A household member may be excluded by a signed named driver exclusion | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | No | No |
| A financial-responsibility filing may be carried | Yes | Yes | Yes | No | No | No |

## Reading the chart

The incident figures are maximums: a count at or below the figure passes, a count above it fails. The licensing, prior insurance and age figures are minimums: a value at or above the figure passes.

Hypothetical comparisons:

- Rated drivers with one major violation in the lookback between them: passes the Cardinal Auto Essential, Cardinal Auto Basic and Cardinal Auto Standard gate (1 or more allowed), fails Cardinal Auto Plus, Cardinal Auto Preferred and Cardinal Auto Premier (0 allowed).
- A named insured first licensed four full years ago: meets the licensing gate of every package except Cardinal Auto Premier, which requires 5.
- Two minor violations in the lookback: pass every package except Cardinal Auto Premier, which allows 1.
